snippet.title: Ember Island - Official Gameplay Trailer (New 2D Action Adventure Game)
snippet.description:
Discover Ember Island, a brand new 2D action-adventure game! This official gameplay trailer is the public's first look at the fast-paced, side-scrolling action.

Ember Island is a love letter to the golden era of 2D games, blending the nostalgic soul of retro classics with stunning modern pixel art and fluid, responsive combat. In this trailer, you'll see a glimpse of the vibrant world, epic boss fights, and challenging platforming that awaits.

Wishlist Ember Island on Steam today to be notified when the full game is available!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3976950/Ember_Island/

Key Features:

Classic Side-Scrolling Action
Modern Pixel Art
Intuitive, Fast-Paced Combat
Epic Boss Encounters
